brief.intent: Vela is a bold, precise training journal for people who want purposeful movement, not a gamified medical authority. Ink, electric lime and cobalt; oversized confident numerals; asymmetric editorial hierarchy; generous grouped space; one primary action per screen; expressive spring page entrances with clear anticipation, hold and release. Phone-first native app, useful iPad split/rail adaptation and desktop companion. Content and accessible controls remain intact under text enlargement and reduced motion.

states.purpose: Understand readiness and choose one purposeful session
Inspect an interval session before committing
Run, pause, resume and finish a local training timer
Release effort and record the completed local session
Review clearly labeled sample history and local completed sessions

requirements: Use resolved region bindings and transition topology, not hardcoded replacement geometry
Maintain natural text heights, 44pt minimum iOS control targets and safe areas
Native font scaling stays enabled; reflow topology changes with text scale
Reduced motion substitutes a short opacity transition with no spatial movement
Final rendering and task proofs required before accepted status
